car_questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes the appearance of pedestrian crosswalk markings?
options: (1) Zebra stripes are white longitudinal stripes parallel to the road centerline; sleeper stripes are white diagonal lines.
(2) Zebra stripes are white diagonal lines; sleeper stripes are white transverse lines perpendicular to the road centerline.
(3) Zebra stripes and sleeper stripes look identical and are distinguished only by their location.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Zebra stripes are white diagonal lines; sleeper stripes are white transverse lines perpendicular to the road centerline..

car_questions.question: On a road section with a no-stopping sign posted:
options: (1) Only parking is prohibited; temporary stopping is allowed.
(2) Temporary stopping is prohibited only during the daytime.
(3) Both temporary stopping and parking are prohibited at all times.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both temporary stopping and parking are prohibited at all times..

car_questions.question: Regarding road access rights for large heavy motorcycles with engine displacement exceeding 250cc, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Large heavy motorcycles of 250cc or above may travel on expressways.
(2) Large heavy motorcycles of 550cc or above may travel on expressways.
(3) Large heavy motorcycles of 550cc or above may only travel on expressway sections that have been officially designated and announced.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Large heavy motorcycles of 550cc or above may only travel on expressway sections that have been officially designated and announced..

car_questions.question: Both 'No Oncoming Traffic' and 'No Overtaking' are red circular prohibitory signs involving a two-vehicle relationship. Which of the following correctly describes the difference in what each sign regulates?
options: (1) 'No Oncoming Traffic' prohibits vehicles traveling in the same direction from overtaking the vehicle ahead; 'No Overtaking' prohibits oncoming vehicles from passing each other on that road section.

(2) 'No Oncoming Traffic' prohibits oncoming vehicles from passing each other on that road section; 'No Overtaking' prohibits vehicles traveling in the same direction from crossing into the oncoming lane to overtake the vehicle ahead.
(3) Both signs prohibit vehicles from crossing the road centerline; they differ only in the width of road section to which they apply.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 'No Oncoming Traffic' prohibits oncoming vehicles from passing each other on that road section; 'No Overtaking' prohibits vehicles traveling in the same direction from crossing into the oncoming lane to overtake the vehicle ahead..

car_questions.question: From which of the following dates are newly licensed automobile drivers prohibited from riding light motorcycles?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) June 30, 2023..

car_questions.question: Regarding professional drivers of small vehicles, what is the maximum age to which the professional driving age can be extended, after which the driver must apply to exchange for an ordinary driver's license of the same vehicle category?
options: (1) 65 years old.
(2) 68 years old.
(3) 70 years old.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 70 years old..

car_questions.question: Where is the deceleration lane on a freeway located?
options: (1) On the innermost side of the main lanes.
(2) Between the main lanes and the ramp, exclusively for vehicles exiting from the main lanes to the ramp.
(3) Between the ramp and the main lanes, exclusively for vehicles merging from the ramp onto the main lanes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Between the main lanes and the ramp, exclusively for vehicles exiting from the main lanes to the ramp..

car_questions.question: Forcibly overtaking a vehicle without being yielded to by the vehicle ahead?
options: (1) Whether it is a violation depends on the road section being driven.
(2) It is not a violation and will not be penalized.
(3) It is a violation and shall be subject to a fine.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) It is a violation and shall be subject to a fine..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle is traveling on a freeway under normal weather conditions at a speed of 100 kilometers per hour, what is the minimum safe following distance between vehicles?
options: (1) 80 meters for large vehicles, 50 meters for small vehicles.
(2) 90 meters for large vehicles, 50 meters for small vehicles.
(3) 80 meters for large vehicles, 60 meters for small vehicles.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) 80 meters for large vehicles, 50 meters for small vehicles..

car_questions.question: If a motor vehicle driver is involved in an accident where no one is injured or killed and fails to handle the situation as required, what is the fine?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) NT$1,000–3,000..

car_questions.question: During vehicle operation, if there is sudden acceleration or sudden braking, which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: (1) The probability of an accident increases.
(2) Tires and brake pads wear out faster.
(3) It will not generate exhaust pollution.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) It will not generate exhaust pollution..

car_questions.question: Which of the following reversing behaviors by a driver does NOT violate traffic regulations?
options: (1) Reversing on a one-way road section to save driving time.
(2) Reversing and turning around in front of a railway level crossing.
(3) Reversing a short distance when parking at the roadside.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Reversing a short distance when parking at the roadside..

car_questions.question: Which of the following diagrams shows a traffic control signal?
options: (1) Option 1
(2) Option 2
(3) Option 3
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Option 2.

car_questions.question: For large heavy motorcycles with a total engine displacement of 550 cc or more, which of the following is NOT in compliance with regulations when riding on freeways and expressways?
options: (1) A full-face or open- face helmet must be worn.
(2) Headlights must be on at all times.
(3) Carrying passengers is limited to one person.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Carrying passengers is limited to one person..

car_questions.question: What is the function of the yellow double solid lines in the diagram?
options: (1) To separate opposing lanes of traffic, with overtaking prohibited in both directions.
(2) To separate lanes traveling in the same direction, with lane changes prohibited in both directions.
(3) To separate lanes traveling in the same direction, with lane changes prohibited in one direction.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) To separate opposing lanes of traffic, with overtaking prohibited in both directions..

car_questions.question: A person holding a large bus driver's license?
options: (1) May drive an articulated truck.
(2) May drive a large heavy motorcycle.
(3) May drive a large truck.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) May drive a large truck..

car_questions.question: Regarding driver behavior, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Complying with traffic laws and order can only be considered a quality driver, and has nothing to do with driving ethics.
(2) Complying with traffic laws and order not only makes one a quality driver, but is also part of driving ethics.
(3) Driving ethics only relates to yielding to pedestrians and has nothing to do with obeying traffic laws.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Complying with traffic laws and order not only makes one a quality driver, but is also part of driving ethics..

car_questions.question: Regarding special vehicles such as fire trucks, ambulances, police patrol vehicles, emergency rescue vehicles, and toxic chemical disaster response vehicles, which of the following statements about their speed limits is correct?
options: (1) Their driving speed is completely unrestricted by any regulations.
(2) When performing emergency duties, they are not subject to speed restrictions.
(3) When performing duties, they are the same as ordinary vehicles and must comply with speed limit regulations.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When performing emergency duties, they are not subject to speed restrictions..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver causes an accident; if no one is injured or killed and the vehicle is still drivable, but the driver fails to promptly mark the vehicle's position and move it to the roadside, causing obstruction to traffic, what is the penalty according to regulations?
options: (1) The driver shall be fined between NT$3,000 and NT$6,000.
(2) The driver shall be fined between NT$600 and NT$1,800.
(3) The vehicle owner shall be fined between NT$1,200 and NT$3,600.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The driver shall be fined between NT$600 and NT$1,800..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver holds a small vehicle driver's license but drives an articulated truck, large bus, or large truck. What is the penalty?
options: (1) The driver shall be fined between NT$36,000 and NT$60,000, and one traffic violation record shall be added to the vehicle.
(2) The vehicle owner shall be fined between NT$36,000 and NT$60,000.
(3) Both the vehicle owner and the driver shall each be fined between NT$40,000 and NT$80,000, and one traffic violation record shall be added to the vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both the vehicle owner and the driver shall each be fined between NT$40,000 and NT$80,000, and one traffic violation record shall be added to the vehicle..

car_questions.question: When a vehicle reaches an uphill and downhill slope of approximately equal gradient, if 2nd gear is used going uphill, which gear should be selected going downhill to achieve fuel efficiency, safety, and time savings?
options: (1) Drive in 3rd or 4th gear.
(2) Shift into neutral (N gear).
(3) Drive in 2nd or 1st gear.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Drive in 2nd or 1st gear..

car_questions.question: As shown in the figure, what type of road marking is the 'yellow dashed line' marked in the middle of the road?
options: (1) Lane line.
(2) Road edge line.
(3) Traffic directional dividing line.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Traffic directional dividing line..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver hears the siren of a fire truck, ambulance, police patrol vehicle, engineering rescue vehicle, or toxic chemical disaster response vehicle and fails to yield immediately, what penalty will be imposed under the Road Traffic Management Penalty Act?
options: (1) A fine of not less than NT$1,200 and not more than NT$2,400, and suspension of the driver's license.
(2) A fine of not less than NT$3,600 and not more than NT$30,000, and suspension of the driver's license.
(3) A fine of not less than NT$6,000 and not more than NT$30,000, revocation of the driver's license, and suspension of the vehicle's license plate for 6 months.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) A fine of not less than NT$6,000 and not more than NT$30,000, revocation of the driver's license, and suspension of the vehicle's license plate for 6 months..

car_questions.question: Regarding the penalty for a driver who fails to yield to emergency vehicles such as fire trucks and ambulances upon hearing their sirens, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) If the driver fails to yield but no accident occurs, a fine of NT$3,600 and 1 demerit point are imposed; if the failure causes death or injury, the penalty is increased to a fine of NT$6,000 to NT$30,000 and suspension of the driver's license.
(2) Regardless of whether an accident occurs, a uniform fine of NT$10,000 to NT$100,000 and revocation of the driver's license are imposed to deter drivers from taking chances.

(3) If the driver fails to yield without causing an accident, a fine of not less than NT$6,000 and not more than NT$30,000 and 3 demerit points are imposed; if the failure causes death or injury, the penalty is increased to a fine of NT$10,000 to NT$100,000, revocation of the driver's license, and revocation of the vehicle's license plate.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) If the driver fails to yield without causing an accident, a fine of not less than NT$6,000 and not more than NT$30,000 and 3 demerit points are imposed; if the failure causes death or injury, the penalty is increased to a fine of NT$10,000 to NT$100,000, revocation of the driver's license, and revocation of the vehicle's license plate..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle is traveling on a general road (not a highway or expressway), if the driver or passenger is not wearing a seatbelt, how much is the fine imposed on the driver?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) NT$1,500..

car_questions.question: What does this traffic controller's hand gesture mean?
options: (1) Vehicles from the left may turn right.
(2) Vehicles from the right may turn left.
(3) Vehicles from the left may turn left.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Vehicles from the right may turn left..

car_questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
options: (1) The road ahead is closed; a U-turn is required.
(2) There is a fork in the road ahead.
(3) There is an obstacle or traffic island ahead; vehicles should travel in separate lanes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) There is an obstacle or traffic island ahead; vehicles should travel in separate lanes..

car_questions.question: What is the 'double solid yellow line' used to divide the road into two-way lanes, prohibiting vehicles from crossing and making U-turns?
options: (1) Directional dividing line.
(2) Road edge line.
(3) Lane change prohibition line.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Directional dividing line..

car_questions.question: The sign in the figure urges vehicle drivers to slow down; what location is approaching?
options: (1) Rest stop.
(2) First-aid station.
(3) Fork in the road.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Fork in the road..

car_questions.question: What is the main category of a traffic sign with a red-bordered triangle, white background, and black markings?
options: (1) Caution sign.
(2) Regulatory sign.
(3) Warning sign.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Warning sign..

car_questions.question: When driving on a national freeway, if you see '2,000m' or '2km' marked below the interchange exit advance notice sign, what does it mean?
options: (1) It represents the deceleration distance from the sign to the interchange exit.
(2) It represents the interchange number.
(3) It represents that the distance from the sign to the upcoming interchange exit is 2,000 meters.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) It represents that the distance from the sign to the upcoming interchange exit is 2,000 meters..

car_questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
options: (1) Harbor/Port.
(2) Ferry crossing.
(3) Repair station.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Ferry crossing..

car_questions.question: Starting from June 30, 2023 (Republic of China Year 112), what is the regulation regarding driving light motorcycles with a newly obtained automobile driver's license?
options: (1) A car driver's license can still be used to drive light motorcycles.
(2) Light motorcycles may not be driven.
(3) Light motorcycles may only be driven in remote areas.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Light motorcycles may not be driven..

car_questions.question: At an intersection where going straight and turning left are both prohibited, and only right turns are allowed, which sign(s) should be installed?
options: (1) Install only a 'No Left Turn' prohibitory sign; drivers will naturally choose to turn right.
(2) Install a 'Right Turn Only' mandatory sign to positively indicate that only right turns are permitted.
(3) Install both a 'No Left Turn' and a 'No Straight Ahead' prohibitory sign simultaneously.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Install a 'Right Turn Only' mandatory sign to positively indicate that only right turns are permitted..

car_questions.question: For a professional small vehicle driver aged 68 or above who wishes to extend their professional driver's license validity until age 70, which of the following regulations is correct?
options: (1) As long as the physical examination is deemed qualified, the extension can be granted directly regardless of whether there was any penalty record in the previous year.

(2) The driver must have had no license suspension penalty in the previous year, pass a physical examination, and submit proof of passing a cognitive function test or a certificate of no dementia; the license may then be renewed or annotated for extension each year.
(3) Only a certificate of no dementia needs to be submitted, and a professional driver's license valid for two years can be issued at once.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The driver must have had no license suspension penalty in the previous year, pass a physical examination, and submit proof of passing a cognitive function test or a certificate of no dementia; the license may then be renewed or annotated for extension each year..

car_questions.question: For a person who has not yet obtained a driver's license and is subject to a 'license suspension' penalty under the Road Traffic Management Penalty Act, what are the regulations regarding their application to obtain a driver's license?
options: (1) Once all fines are paid, they may immediately participate in the driver's license examination.
(2) During the maximum stipulated suspension period, they may not apply for or obtain a driver's license.
(3) They must undergo one month of re-education for traffic violations before being allowed to take the driver's license examination.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) During the maximum stipulated suspension period, they may not apply for or obtain a driver's license..

car_questions.question: When fire trucks, ambulances, police cars, and emergency engineering vehicles on duty are traveling on a road with two or more lanes in the same direction, where may they travel?
options: (1) Only the inner lane.
(2) Only the outer lane.
(3) Both inner and outer lanes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Both inner and outer lanes..

car_questions.question: Those subject to permanent revocation or suspension of their driver's license must first complete a traffic violation education course (re-application examination class) before taking the driver's license exam. How many hours of instruction are required for the automobile class?
options: (1) 2 days, 15 hours total.
(2) 2.5 days, 18 hours total.
(3) 3 days, 24 hours total.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 2.5 days, 18 hours total..

car_questions.question: Both the "One-Way Street" sign and the "Road Direction of Travel" sign have white arrows on a blue background. Which of the following correctly describes the difference between the two?
options: (1) The "One- Way Street" sign is circular, placed at intersections, indicating that traffic at the intersection may only proceed in the direction of the arrow.

(2) The "Road Direction of Travel" sign is circular, placed at intersections, indicating that vehicles must proceed in the direction of the arrow; the "One-Way Street" sign is rectangular, placed on one-way roads, indicating that only one-directional travel is permitted on that road section.
(3) The two differ only in name; their functions and placement locations are completely identical and they can be used interchangeably.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The "Road Direction of Travel" sign is circular, placed at intersections, indicating that vehicles must proceed in the direction of the arrow; the "One-Way Street" sign is rectangular, placed on one-way roads, indicating that only one-directional travel is permitted on that road section..

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver causes an accident resulting in injury or death of another person, which of the following responses is correct?
options: (1) Immediately move the vehicle involved in the accident to the roadside without waiting for the consent of the parties involved.
(2) Remove evidence at the scene that is unfavorable to our side.
(3) Immediately take rescue and first aid measures.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Immediately take rescue and first aid measures..

car_questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
options: (1) Lane divergence.
(2) Fork in the road.
(3) Road direction of travel.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Road direction of travel..

car_questions.question: After a driver stops at an intersection following a traffic officer's stop signal and then sees the officer signal to allow movement in their direction, how should the driver proceed?
options: (1) Accelerate immediately to avoid delaying vehicles behind.
(2) Before moving, still pay attention to the movement of people and vehicles within the intersection, and proceed smoothly only after confirming it is safe.
(3) Wait at least five seconds to confirm the signal has stopped changing before proceeding.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Before moving, still pay attention to the movement of people and vehicles within the intersection, and proceed smoothly only after confirming it is safe..

car_questions.question: If a motor vehicle driver removes the muffler and causes noise pollution, what is the duration of the fine, on-the-spot prohibition from driving, and suspension of the vehicle license plate?
options: (1) 6 months.
(2) 3 months.
(3) 2 months.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) 6 months..

car_questions.question: For patients with epilepsy who can provide a medical certificate from a physician at a medical institution stating that there has been no seizure for the past 2 or more years, which of the following applies?
options: (1) They are still not eligible to apply for a driver's license.
(2) They may only apply for a motorcycle license.
(3) They may apply for both a motorcycle license and an ordinary small vehicle license.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) They may apply for both a motorcycle license and an ordinary small vehicle license..

car_questions.question: When using high-beam headlights while driving at night, in which of the following situations should you immediately switch to low-beam headlights?
options: (1) When passing through well-lit urban roads, you may keep the high beams on to improve your own visibility.
(2) When meeting oncoming vehicles or approaching vehicles traveling in the same direction ahead, you should switch to low-beam headlights to avoid causing glare to others.
(3) You only need to switch to low-beam headlights when entering a tunnel; high beams may be used throughout all other road sections.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) When meeting oncoming vehicles or approaching vehicles traveling in the same direction ahead, you should switch to low-beam headlights to avoid causing glare to others..

car_questions.question: What is the passing score for the road test portion of the driver's license examination?
options: (1) 60 points.
(2) 70 points.
(3) 80 points.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 70 points..

car_questions.question: Motorcycles with a total engine displacement of less than how many cubic centimeters are prohibited from traveling on expressways?
options: (1) Less than 450 cc.
(2) Less than 550 cc.
(3) Less than 650 cc.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Less than 550 cc..

car_questions.question: Regarding the route numbering of Taiwan's national freeway system, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) National Freeway No. 1 is an east-west expressway.
(2) National Freeway No. 3 is a north-south expressway.
(3) National Freeway No. 5 is the western longitudinal expressway.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) National Freeway No. 3 is a north-south expressway..

car_questions.question: In the same direction, a white dashed line (lane line) and a white solid line (no lane change line) are painted between lanes. Which of the following correctly describes the difference between the two?
options: (1) A white dashed line means vehicles may change lanes when it is safe to do so; a white solid line means lane changes are prohibited.
(2) A white dashed line means the lane is about to end and vehicles should merge into an adjacent lane as soon as possible; a white solid line means lane changes are permitted normally.
(3) Both have the same function of dividing lanes; the dashed and solid lines merely indicate the grade of the road section.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A white dashed line means vehicles may change lanes when it is safe to do so; a white solid line means lane changes are prohibited..

car_questions.question: Is it correct that the faster a car travels, the more fuel-efficient it is?
options: (1) Correct, driving at high speed shortens travel time and therefore saves fuel.
(2) Correct, as long as a constant high speed is maintained, it is always the most fuel-efficient.
(3) Incorrect, excessively high speeds increase wind resistance and fuel consumption.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Incorrect, excessively high speeds increase wind resistance and fuel consumption..

car_questions.question: A sign prohibiting entry of vehicles with four or more wheels is posted at a road entrance. Which of the following vehicles may enter that road section?
options: (1) A private passenger car, because it is a small vehicle and not within the scope of the restriction.
(2) A standard heavy motorcycle, because it is not a vehicle with four or more wheels.
(3) A light truck, because it is used for cargo transport and differs in nature from ordinary automobiles.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A standard heavy motorcycle, because it is not a vehicle with four or more wheels..

car_questions.question: 1. What is the managing authority for freeways and expressways?
options: (1) The Freeway Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications and the Highways Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications.
(2) Both are managed by the Highways Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications.
(3) The Institute of Transportation of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The Freeway Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications and the Highways Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Fork road.
(2) Narrow bridge.
(3) Narrow road.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Narrow bridge..

car_questions.question: 2. If a vehicle evades toll payment on a highway or bridge that requires a fee, and as a result a toll collector is injured or killed, the driver shall?
options: (1) Have their vehicle license plate confiscated for 6 months.
(2) Have their driver's license suspended for 6 months.
(3) Have their driver's license revoked.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Have their driver's license revoked..

car_questions.question: 3. Regarding the difference between the two prohibition signs "No Entry for Any Vehicle" and "No Through Traffic", which of the following descriptions is correct?
options: (1) "No Entry for Any Vehicle" prohibits both vehicles and pedestrians; "No Through Traffic" prohibits vehicles only.
(2) "No Entry for Any Vehicle" prohibits vehicles only and pedestrians are not restricted; "No Through Traffic" prohibits both vehicles and pedestrians.
(3) Both signs apply to exactly the same subjects and only differ in the road section level where they are placed, and may be used interchangeably.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) "No Entry for Any Vehicle" prohibits vehicles only and pedestrians are not restricted; "No Through Traffic" prohibits both vehicles and pedestrians..

car_questions.question: 4. When reversing, if the driver finds that their line of sight is obstructed or cannot fully confirm through the rearview mirror whether the area behind the vehicle is safe, which of the following actions is most correct?
options: (1) Focus entirely on the reversing camera or radar display and there is no need to get out of the vehicle.
(2) Continuously hold down the horn as a warning and slowly accelerate while reversing.
(3) The driver should get out of the vehicle and personally inspect the actual situation before reversing.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) The driver should get out of the vehicle and personally inspect the actual situation before reversing..

car_questions.question: 5. When a vehicle reaches a channelization zone, what is the correct action?
options: (1) Vehicles may stop to pick up or drop off passengers.
(2) Vehicles may stop briefly but must not park for an extended period.
(3) Vehicles must not enter or cross over the channelization zone.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Vehicles must not enter or cross over the channelization zone..

car_questions.question: Regarding the regulations for a person holding a domestic driver's license to apply for an 'International Driving Permit', which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) After obtaining the International Driving Permit, the original domestic driver's license becomes invalid and is confiscated by the highway supervisory authority.
(2) One must pass the international road traffic signs examination again before being eligible to obtain it.
(3) Within the validity period of the domestic driver's license, one may exchange it for an International Driving Permit of the same vehicle category.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Within the validity period of the domestic driver's license, one may exchange | Year 115 Edition it for an International Driving Permit of the same vehicle category..

car_questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
options: (1) Two-way traffic.
(2) Narrow road.
(3) Fork road.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Two-way traffic..

car_questions.question: Regarding large heavy motorcycles with a total engine displacement of 550cc or more, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) They may travel on expressways on any road and at any time.
(2) Riders with excellent driving skills are exempt from road restrictions.
(3) They must travel on designated roads and during designated times, and may not enter expressways arbitrarily.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) They must travel on designated roads and during designated times, and may not enter expressways arbitrarily..

car_questions.question: Regarding the regulations on the use of vehicle license plates, which of the following is correct?

car_questions.question: If a motor vehicle driver causes serious injury or death to another person in an accident and flees the scene, what is the penalty for their driver's license?
options: (1) Suspension of the driver's license for 1 year.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Revocation of the driver's license, with a permanent ban on reapplying, except for those meeting specific conditions..

car_questions.question: If a person uses a motor vehicle to commit a crime and receives a confirmed sentence of imprisonment or higher, what will happen?
options: (1) Their driver's license will be revoked.
(2) Their driver's license will be suspended.
(3) Their license will be reissued as a high-risk driver's license.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Their driver's license will be revoked..

car_questions.question: When turning a car's steering wheel more than half a turn, which operating method should be used?
options: (1) Smooth hand-over-hand (push-pull) rotation.

car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Continuous cross- hand rotation..

car_questions.question: What is a road whose access points are fully controlled, has a divided median for two-way traffic, intersects with other roads only via grade separation except at origin and destination points, and is exclusively for motor vehicles?

car_questions.question: When a vehicle driver causes death or injury to others due to negligence, in addition to administrative liability, what other liability must they bear?
options: (1) Criminal liability.

car_questions.question: Regarding a person subject to a lifetime ban from obtaining a driver's license, which of the following is correct?

car_questions.question: Regarding a learner's driving permit for automobiles, which of the following is correct?

car_questions.question: When a person resists a police officer performing traffic duty or a person legally conducting a traffic enforcement inspection, resulting in injury or death, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) Only a fine and license revocation will be imposed, and the person may still reapply for a driver's license.

car_questions.question: Regarding fire trucks, police vehicles, and emergency rescue vehicles on duty:
options: (1) They may stop briefly in emergency situations but must still comply with general parking restrictions.

car_questions.question: Regarding Taiwan's highway route numbering system, which uses odd and even numbers to distinguish road orientation, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) Odd numbers represent east-west roads, and even numbers represent north-south roads.

(3) The odd or even numbers are merely sequential serial numbers and have no relation to road orientation.

car_questions.question: Regarding the time limit for idling while a vehicle is parked, which of the following is correct?
options: (1) A vehicle may idle continuously while parked with no time limit.

car_questions.question: Regarding the use of road signs on freeways or expressways, which of the following is correct?

car_questions.question: When a car is traveling in a lane shared with mass rapid transit (MRT) vehicles and the driver hears or sees signals or lights indicating an approaching MRT vehicle, which of the following actions is correct?
options: (1) The driver shall immediately change lanes as required to yield priority passage to the MRT vehicle and must not follow closely behind it. However, this does not apply where the road authority has made other provisions.

car_questions.question: When driving on a long downhill slope, what is the safest way to operate the vehicle in order to avoid brake failure caused by overuse of the brakes?

car_questions.question: When a light truck must carry on-duty crew members for operational needs, what is the regulation regarding the number of such passengers?

car_questions.question: Regarding traffic accidents on freeways and expressways, which respective authority has full responsibility for handling each type?

car_questions.question: When taking the driver's license examination, what is the passing score for the written test (traffic regulations)?

car_questions.question: To achieve eco-friendly and fuel-efficient driving habits, which of the following driving behaviors should be avoided to reduce fuel consumption?

car_questions.question: When a motor vehicle driver runs a red light at an intersection controlled by traffic signals and causes an accident resulting in serious injury to another person, which of the following regarding driver's license penalties is correct?

car_questions.question: After a vehicle drives through a flooded road section, what effect does it have on the braking system?

car_questions.question: When a driver passes through an intersection with a pedestrian crosswalk and notices a pedestrian preparing to cross, which of the following actions is correct?

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver involved in an accident with no injuries or deaths who fails to follow required procedures and flees the scene, in addition to a fine, shall have their:
options: (1) Vehicle registration suspended.
(2) Driver's license suspended.
(3) Driver's license revoked.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Driver's license suspended..

car_questions.question: A driver who fails to drive on the right side of the center of an unmarked road shall be subject to:
options: (1) Driver's license suspension.
(2) A fine.
(3) Vehicle registration suspension.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A fine..

car_questions.question: No temporary stopping is allowed within how many meters of a fire hydrant or fire station entrance?
options: (1) 10 meters.
(2) 5 meters.
(3) 15 meters.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 5 meters..

car_questions.question: When driving near schools or hospitals:
options: (1) Honk frequently to alert students or patients.
(2) Unless in an emergency or dangerous situation, honking is prohibited.
(3) Only one short honk is allowed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Unless in an emergency or dangerous situation, honking is prohibited..

car_questions.question: When driving through road sections marked with school or hospital signs, you should:
options: (1) Slow down and be prepared to stop at any time.
(2) Honk frequently to alert pedestrians.
(3) Speed up to avoid congestion.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Slow down and be prepared to stop at any time..

car_questions.question: On roads with heavy traffic in urban areas:
options: (1) You may overtake after honking two long horn blasts.
(2) You may overtake after honking two short horn blasts.
(3) Honking or overtaking is not permitted.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Honking or overtaking is not permitted. | Year 115 Edition.

car_questions.question: Vehicles with temporary license plates:
options: (1) Must not carry passengers or cargo for commercial purposes.
(2) May carry cargo commercially.
(3) No regulation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Must not carry passengers or cargo for commercial purposes..

car_questions.question: When the driver of a vehicle ahead hears the horn of an overtaking vehicle from behind, if there are no obstacles ahead:
options: (1) The driver should slow down and move to the side, or signal to yield.
(2) There is no need to yield.
(3) Accelerate.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The driver should slow down and move to the side, or signal to yield..

car_questions.question: Upon hearing the siren of a fire truck, ambulance, police vehicle, emergency rescue vehicle, or hazardous materials response vehicle, regardless of direction:
options: (1) Yield immediately.
(2) No need to yield.
(3) No need to yield as long as you stay in your lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Yield immediately..

car_questions.question: When a railway crossing barrier has not been lowered, or the watchman has not signaled to stop, you should:
options: (1) Still look and listen to confirm no train is approaching from either direction before crossing.
(2) Speed up to cross.
(3) Wait for the watchman's signal before crossing.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Still look and listen to confirm no train is approaching from either direction before crossing..

car_questions.question: A scrapped vehicle:
options: (1) May not be re-registered or re-licensed for use.
(2) May be re-registered after repair.
(3) No regulation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) May not be re-registered or re-licensed for use..

car_questions.question: Those who use forged, altered, or fraudulently obtained license plates shall be subject to:
options: (1) A fine and prohibition from driving.
(2) Confiscation of the license plates.
(3) A fine, confiscation of the license plates, and on-site impoundment of the vehicle.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) A fine, confiscation of the license plates, and on-site impoundment of the vehicle..

car_questions.question: A driver shall be required to attend road safety training in which of the following situations?
options: (1) Running through a railway level crossing.
(2) Temporarily stopping within 10 meters of an intersection.
(3) Failing to maintain a safe distance when changing lanes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Running through a railway level crossing..

car_questions.question: Private small passenger vehicles with license plates (except those using LPG or CNG) must be inspected:
options: (1) Exempt from periodic inspection if less than 5 years old; at least once per year if 5 to 10 years old; at least twice per year if over 10 years old.
(2) At least 3 times per year if over 10 years old.
(3) At least twice per year if less than 5 years old.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Exempt from periodic inspection if less than 5 years old; at least once per year if 5 to 10 years old; at least twice per year if over 10 years old..

car_questions.question: A person who drives a small vehicle during the period when their small vehicle driver's license is suspended shall, in addition to a fine of NT$36,000–60,000 and immediate impoundment of the vehicle on the spot, also:
options: (1) Have their vehicle registration certificate suspended again.
(2) Have their driver's license suspended again.
(3) Have their driver's license revoked.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Have their driver's license revoked..

car_questions.question: Illegally parking in a disabled parking space:
options: (1) Subject to a fine.
(2) Subject to license plate suspension.
(3) Subject to a verbal warning.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Subject to a fine..

car_questions.question: Lending a license plate to another vehicle or using another vehicle's plate: in addition to a fine:
options: (1) The license plate shall be suspended.
(2) The license plate shall be revoked.
(3) The vehicle shall be confiscated.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The license plate shall be revoked..

car_questions.question: The penalty for a motor vehicle driver who fails to comply with traffic control regulations while driving on a freeway or expressway and is cited on the spot is:
options: (1) Demerit points only, no fine.
(2) Fine and demerit points recorded.
(3) Fine only.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Fine and demerit points recorded..

car_questions.question: Overtaking, making a U-turn, reversing, or parking on a railway level crossing:
options: (1) Subject to a fine.
(2) Subject to a fine and demerit points.
(3) Subject to a fine and driver's license suspension.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Subject to a fine and driver's license suspension..

car_questions.question: The penalty for forcibly crossing a railway level crossing is:
options: (1) A fine and driver's license suspension.
(2) Driver's license revocation.
(3) A fine.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A fine and driver's license suspension..

car_questions.question: A driver who has had their license suspended twice within 2 years due to demerit points and commits another point-worthy violation shall:
options: (1) Have their driver's license suspended.
(2) Have their driver's license revoked.
(3) Be fined.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Have their driver's license revoked..

car_questions.question: Abandoned vehicles occupying public roads, after being reported by the public or identified by police or environmental protection authorities, and the owner is notified but fails to remove the vehicle by the deadline:
options: (1) The environmental authority may tow and store the vehicle and charge the owner for costs.
(2) Leave it as is.
(3) Destroy it immediately.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The environmental authority may tow and store the vehicle and charge the owner for costs..

car_questions.question: Abandoned vehicles towed and stored by environmental or contracted agencies, after public notice, if unclaimed for how long, may be disposed of as waste?
options: (1) 1 month.
(2) 2 months.
(3) 3 months.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) 1 month..

car_questions.question: When automatically recording a speeding violation, consecutive citations may be issued if the violation locations are at least:
options: (1) 14 km apart.
(2) 8 km apart.
(3) 6 km apart. However, this does not apply to violations inside tunnels.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 6 km apart. However, this does not apply to violations inside tunnels. | Year 115 Edition.

car_questions.question: After receiving a traffic violation notice, the vehicle owner or driver may, within:
options: (1) 10 days.
(2) 30 days.
(3) 50 days. pay the fine at the designated location without going through formal adjudication.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 30 days..

car_questions.question: If the front seat of a small passenger vehicle or the cab of a truck carries more passengers than permitted, the driver shall be subject to:
options: (1) Driver's license suspension.
(2) A fine.
(3) A fine and driver's license suspension.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) A fine..

car_questions.question: In a hit-and-run case, if the vehicle owner is notified to appear for explanation but fails to appear without justification, or refuses to provide information about the driver:
options: (1) The vehicle license plate shall be revoked.
(2) The vehicle license plate shall be suspended.
(3) The vehicle owner's driver's license shall be suspended.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The vehicle license plate shall be suspended..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver driving lawfully in the fast lane who causes injury or death because a pedestrian or slow vehicle unlawfully enters the fast lane, if criminally liable, shall have their penalty:
options: (1) Unchanged.
(2) Reduced.
(3) Increased.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Reduced..

car_questions.question: If the penalized person disagrees with the adjudication, they should file a lawsuit against the original adjudicating agency with the Administrative Litigation Division of the High Administrative Court; the appeal must be filed within:
options: (1) 10 days.
(2) 20 days.
(3) 30 days. from the date the adjudication is served.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 30 days. from the date the adjudication is served..

car_questions.question: Which of the following violations may be cited directly against the vehicle owner?
options: (1) Driving without a license.
(2) Drunk driving.
(3) Illegal parking with the driver absent.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Illegal parking with the driver absent..

car_questions.question: An unauthorized assembled vehicle driven without approved registration, or a scrapped vehicle still driven on roads, shall have the vehicle:
options: (1) Confiscated and fined.
(2) Auctioned publicly.
(3) Returned after the fine is paid.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Confiscated and fined..

car_questions.question: A driver who operates a heavy truck, bus, or articulated vehicle without a license, in addition to a fine, shall:
options: (1) Have the license plate revoked.
(2) Be prohibited from driving on the spot.
(3) Have the vehicle confiscated.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Be prohibited from driving on the spot..

car_questions.question: When driving on a freeway or expressway, if the driver, front-seat passengers, or rear-seat passengers of a small vehicle fail to wear seatbelts, the driver shall be fined:
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) NT$3,000–6,000..

car_questions.question: After a parking violation is cited but not corrected, consecutive citations may be issued every:
options: (1) 1 hour.
(2) 2 hours.
(3) 30 minutes.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) 2 hours..

car_questions.question: When automatically recording speeding violations, consecutive citations may be issued when:
options: (1) Violations are at least 4 minutes apart or past 1 intersection.
(2) Violations are at least 5 minutes apart or past 1 intersection.
(3) Violation locations are at least 6 km apart, at least 6 minutes apart, or past 1 intersection. However, this does not apply to violations inside tunnels.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Violation locations are at least 6 km apart, at least 6 minutes apart, or past 1 intersection. However, this does not apply to violations inside tunnels..

car_questions.question: A driver who illegally double-parks shall be fined:
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) NT$1,800 to NT$3,000..

car_questions.question: A motor vehicle driver who, without justification, fails to attend a mandatory road safety course shall be fined NT$1,800. If after re-notification they still fail to attend for more than 6 months, the penalty is:
options: (1) Vehicle registration suspension.
(2) Driver's license revocation.
(3) Driver's license suspension.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Driver's license suspension..

car_questions.question: Before processing vehicle transfer, deregistration, re-registration, license plate surrender, plate cancellation, plate replacement, or driver's license replacement, the vehicle owner or driver:
options: (1) Must.
(2) Does not need to.
(3) No regulation. pay all outstanding violation fines.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Must..

car_questions.question: The speed limit on freeway or expressway ramps is:
options: (3) As indicated by the speed limit sign.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) As indicated by the speed limit sign..

car_questions.question: On freeway sections with a maximum speed limit of 90 km/h or above, slower small vehicles traveling below:
options: (3) 80 km/h. should drive in the outer lane.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 80 km/h. should drive in the outer lane..

car_questions.question: On a freeway or expressway, small vehicles traveling in the same lane at 70 km/h should maintain a minimum following distance of:
options: (1) 15 meters.
(2) 25 meters.
(3) 35 meters.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 35 meters..

car_questions.question: Large vehicles on a freeway or expressway should drive in:
options: (1) The inner lane.
(2) The outer lane.
(3) Either lane freely.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The outer lane..

car_questions.question: While driving on a freeway or expressway:
options: (1) You may not use the shoulder to overtake.
(2) You may use the shoulder to overtake.
(3) You may only use the acceleration lane to overtake.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) You may not use the shoulder to overtake..

car_questions.question: Under normal weather conditions, the maximum speed limit on a freeway or expressway is:
options: (3) As indicated by the speed limit sign.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) As indicated by the speed limit sign..

car_questions.question: In dense fog, smoke, heavy rain, or strong wind with very low visibility, vehicles on a freeway or expressway should:
options: (1) Maintain a minimum speed of 60 km/h.
(2) Drive below 40 km/h or pull over to the shoulder and activate hazard lights.
(3) Maintain normal speed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Drive below 40 km/h or pull over to the shoulder and activate hazard lights..

car_questions.question: On single-lane ramps and acceleration/deceleration lanes:
options: (1) Overtaking is allowed.
(2) Overtaking is not allowed.
(3) Vehicles may stop temporarily.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Overtaking is not allowed..

car_questions.question: If you miss an exit ramp on a freeway or expressway:
options: (1) Pull over and wait for a gap to make a U-turn to the ramp.
(2) Continue to the next exit.
(3) Pull over and wait for a gap to reverse to the ramp.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Continue to the next exit..

car_questions.question: The plum blossom-shaped traffic sign is:
options: (1) A decorative design on the roadside.
(2) An indication of a major highway.
(3) A national highway sign.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) A national highway sign..

car_questions.question: The inner lane of a freeway or expressway is the passing lane, but small vehicles may:
options: (1) Drive slowly.
(2) Not use it.
(3) Drive at the maximum speed limit for that section. in the inner lane when traffic is not obstructed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Drive at the maximum speed limit for that section. in the inner lane when traffic is not obstructed..

car_questions.question: Traffic disorder, congestion, paralysis, and accidents are primarily caused by:
options: (1) Drivers or road users not obeying traffic rules.
(2) Too many vehicles.
(3) Roads not being wide enough.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Drivers or road users not obeying traffic rules..

car_questions.question: Most accidents are caused by human factors and failure to obey traffic rules. Therefore, the priority should be:
options: (1) Traffic rule education and training to cultivate driving ethics.
(2) Raising driving skills test standards.
(3) Teaching vehicle maintenance methods.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Traffic rule education and training to cultivate driving ethics..

car_questions.question: If you feel the vehicle swaying while driving in strong wind:
options: (1) Grip the steering wheel firmly, reduce speed, increase following distance, and avoid changing lanes.
(2) Speed up to pass through.
(3) It does not affect driving safety; no action needed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Grip the steering wheel firmly, reduce speed, increase following distance, and avoid changing lanes..

car_questions.question: At what speed does a small passenger vehicle consume the least fuel on a freeway?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) 80–90 km/h..

car_questions.question: If a vehicle's license plate is lost and not reported for replacement, and the vehicle is still driven after citation:
options: (1) No fine but the vehicle shall be prohibited from driving.
(2) The vehicle owner shall be fined and the vehicle prohibited from driving.
(3) The driver shall be fined.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The vehicle owner shall be fined and the vehicle prohibited from driving..

car_questions.question: A person whose driver's license has been permanently revoked may apply to retest for a license after how many years, in the case of a fatal accident?
options: (1) 8 years.
(2) 10 years.
(3) 12 years.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) 12 years..

car_questions.question: When entering a gas station to refuel:
options: (1) The engine should be turned off before refueling.
(2) Refueling may be done with the engine on or off.
(3) The engine should not be turned off because the air conditioning needs to circulate.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) The engine should be turned off before refueling..

car_questions.question: When entering a gas station to refuel:
options: (1) You may make or receive mobile phone calls.
(2) You may only receive calls but not make them.
(3) Making or receiving mobile phone calls is strictly prohibited.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Making or receiving mobile phone calls is strictly prohibited..

car_questions.question: During an emergency brake in a typical vehicle, if the wheels lock up and you turn the steering wheel to the right, the vehicle's direction of travel will be:
options: (1) To the right.
(2) To the left.
(3) Uncontrollable.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Uncontrollable..

car_questions.question: While driving, if you encounter an accident scene where police are already present:
options: (1) Use your phone to livestream it for friends and family.
(2) Stop to watch and broaden your experience.
(3) Detour away and do not linger at the scene to avoid causing congestion.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Detour away and do not linger at the scene to avoid causing congestion..

car_questions.question: The driving practice route for a learner's permit holder must be approved by:
options: (1) The highway supervision authority.
(2) The highway or urban road authority.
(3) The local police department.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The highway or urban road authority..

car_questions.question: A learner's permit holder should practice driving on:
options: (1) Roads approved by the highway or urban road authority.
(2) Regular surface roads.
(3) Expressways or freeways.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Roads approved by the highway or urban road authority..

car_questions.question: If a learner's permit holder practices without a licensed driver supervising, this is a violation subject to:
options: (1) A fine.
(2) Vehicle impoundment.
(3) License plate revocation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) A fine..

car_questions.question: If a learner's permit holder practices driving on unauthorized roads or outside designated times:
options: (1) This is a violation subject to a fine.
(2) It is acceptable if a driving instructor is present.
(3) There is no specific regulation.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) This is a violation subject to a fine..

car_questions.question: When parking, a vehicle shall be positioned in the direction of traffic flow and kept close to the edge of the roadway. The distance between the outer side of the front and rear tires and the curb or edge of the road shall not exceed:
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) 40 cm.

car_questions.question: When a small vehicle temporarily stops at the roadside, it should be parked facing the direction of traffic, close to the road edge, with the right-side tire outer edges no more than how far from the curb or road edge?
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) 60 cm..

car_questions.question: When temporary stopping is needed, on a road section without a no-stopping restriction:
options: (1) Stop facing the direction of traffic, close to the road edge.
(2) Stop anywhere.
(3) Activate hazard lights and stop anywhere.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Stop facing the direction of traffic, close to the road edge..

car_questions.question: On road sections with curve, steep slope, narrow bridge, or tunnel signs, or at railway level crossings:
options: (1) Reversing is allowed for convenience.
(2) Overtaking is allowed.
(3) Overtaking is not allowed.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Overtaking is not allowed..

car_questions.question: Fire trucks, ambulances, police vehicles, engineering rescue vehicles, and toxic chemical disaster response vehicles that have completed their missions shall travel at a speed that:
options: (1) Is unrestricted.
(2) Does not exceed 50 kilometers per hour.
(3) Complies with the Road Traffic Safety Rules.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Complies with the Road Traffic Safety Rules..

car_questions.question: While driving, if you encounter traffic cones, barricades, guardrails, or other construction closure equipment without workers present, this means:
options: (1) Construction has not started; you may move the barriers and pass carefully.
(2) Construction is finished but barriers remain; you may move them and pass.
(3) You must not enter the construction zone or disturb the equipment.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) You must not enter the construction zone or disturb the equipment..

car_questions.question: When the inner lane is closed for construction, may the outer shoulder be used?
options: (1) Follow the 'Temporary Shoulder' sign to use the shoulder carefully; stop using the shoulder when you see the 'No Shoulder Driving' sign.
(2) The shoulder may be used on all construction sections.
(3) The shoulder may be used when no police are present.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (1) is correct: (1) Follow the 'Temporary Shoulder' sign to use the shoulder carefully; stop using the shoulder when you see the 'No Shoulder Driving' sign..

car_questions.question: Regarding the seatbelt requirement for taxi passengers, if the driver has fulfilled their duty to inform but the passenger still does not wear a seatbelt, who is penalized?
options: (1) The driver.
(2) The passenger.
(3) Neither.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) The passenger..

car_questions.question: Regarding large heavy motorcycles with a total engine displacement of 550cc or more, which of the following statements is correct?
options: (1) They may travel on expressways on any road and at any time.
(2) Riders with excellent driving skills are exempt from road restrictions.
(3) They must travel on designated roads and during designated times, and may not enter expressways arbitrarily.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) They must travel on designated roads and during designated times, and may not enter expressways arbitrarily..

car_questions.question: Which type of weather information is closely related to road disasters and should be closely monitored?
options: (1) Tides.
(2) Rainfall.
(3) Temperature.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Rainfall..

car_questions.question: Which driving behavior is incorrect?
options: (1) Regularly listening to police radio for real-time traffic information.
(2) If stranded on the road, use roadside mileage markers to identify your location for rescue.
(3) When encountering a rockfall blocking the road, park anywhere without checking if the area is safe.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) When encountering a rockfall blocking the road, park anywhere without checking if the area is safe..

car_questions.question: Which is NOT a purpose of road authorities implementing bridge/road closures?
options: (1) Increased risk of road/bridge failure makes it dangerous, so roads are closed in advance to prevent casualties.
(2) To expedite repairs and ensure user safety after disasters or during construction.
(3) Closures are just to inconvenience road users.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Closures are just to inconvenience road users..

car_questions.question: What is the correct way to use the gas pedal and brakes on snowy roads?
options: (1) Press the gas and brakes hard to avoid skidding.
(2) Both the gas and brakes should be controlled very gently.
(3) No different from driving on normal roads.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Both the gas and brakes should be controlled very gently..

car_questions.question: When driving in mountain areas and encountering snow in winter, what is the safest approach?
options: (1) Rush downhill to leave the snowy area.
(2) Install snow chains; if unavailable, do not force driving.
(3) Light snowfall poses no driving safety concern.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (2) is correct: (2) Install snow chains; if unavailable, do not force driving..

car_questions.question: What is the correct way to handle curves on snowy roads?
options: (1) Shift to neutral and coast through the curve.
(2) No need to pump the brakes; just drive through.
(3) Pump the brakes gently to reduce speed and avoid snow/ice in the curve.
car_questions.explanation: According to official Taiwan Traffic Regulations, Choice (3) is correct: (3) Pump the brakes gently to reduce speed and avoid snow/ice in the curve..

car_questions.question: According to vehicle owner manuals for driver assistance systems, under which road condition might the system fail to function correctly, potentially causing a traffic accident?
options: (1) Normal weather conditions.
(2) When the vehicle ahead is centered in the lane.
(3) When there is a large speed difference with the vehicle ahead or the vehicle ahead is stationary.
